about.heading: Who we are & what we do
about.body: Global Youth Network (GYN) is an international organization dedicated to connecting and empowering young people worldwide. We bring together students, professionals, and innovators to collaborate across borders, develop leadership skills, and create meaningful global impact.

services.name: Conferences
services.description: GYN hosts international forums, workshops and summits to promote dialogue on Sustainable Development Goals

services.name: Networking
services.description: The GYN empowers the next generation by providing a collaborative ecosystem of mentorship, technical support and resource sharing to address the world’s most pressing challenges

services.name: Leadership Development
services.description: Empowering a new generation of leaders to navigate complexity with visionary foresight, unwavering integrity and measurable global impact

services.name: Collaborative Networks
services.description: Cultivating a global ecosystem of cross-border dialogue and strategic partnerships to unlock innovative solutions for the world’s most complex challenges

services.name: Youth Mentoring
services.description: Providing tailor-made and hands-on mentoring to youth to become effective leaders

services.name: Workshops & Trainings
services.description: Building leadership capacities and policy expertise for future-ready governance

focus.heading: 4 SDGs, 1 sustainable future
focus.quote: At GYN, we focus on four Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) as education, gender equality, industry – innovation & Infrastructure, and climate action, uniting young leaders worldwide to create impactful solutions and drive positive change for a sustainable future.

goals.label: SDG 13: Climate Action
goals.text: Taking urgent action for our Climate.

items.title: Empowerment
items.text: Priming young leaders with skills, mindset, and confidence to drive systemic change.

items.title: Data Unification
items.text: To collect and unify data and research ideas from across the globe related to SDG 4, SDG 5, SDG 9 and SDG 13

items.title: Research Exploration
items.text: Exploring fields, sharing research, and volunteer work

items.title: Capacity Building
items.text: Bringing scientists, students, NGOs, and legal professionals together through sessions and trainings to foster innovation and peace.

items.title: Policy Round-ups
items.text: To provide a platform for bridging gaps, bringing cross-functional ideas from AI experts, businesses, NGOs, and volunteers through policy & ideas

items.title: Global Collaboration
items.text: Providing a forum for international networking (cross-border dialogue) and cultural exchange.

items.title: Sustainable Impact
items.text: Advancing the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs 4, 5, 9, and 13) through youth-led innovation and leadership skills.

items.title: SDG Innovation Summit Malaysia 2026
items.description: The SDG Innovation Summit Malaysia 2026 brings together 100 young leaders, innovators, entrepreneurs, students, professionals, and changemakers from around the world to exchange ideas, build connections, and drive sustainable impact aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
